name: 带薪年休假 (paid annual leave)
description: Statutory5/10/15-day grant and365-day joining/leaving proration. A matching terms.facts.annual_leave_year_reviews row is required; it records current and following-year disqualification under 实施办法第八条. Preserve already-consumed signed ledger units so a later disqualification never makes the ledger negative. Year-end: extra200% pays unwaived/undeferred units. A valid personal written refusal consumes its reviewed current-year units with a negative ADJUSTMENT and no cash; agreed work-need deferral credits one explicit CARRY_FORWARD movement on1January. Automatic carry is disabled, so old carried units cannot defer twice. Retain review rows for prior years. https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html Initial qualification with zero recorded prior service uses the first anniversary as the proration start, not1January. Cumulative prior-service months alone do not establish uninterrupted external service.

references.title: 职工带薪年休假条例 第二条、第三条: 累计工作满1年不满10年5天, 满10年不满20年10天, 满20年15天; 国家法定休假日、休息日不计入.
职工带薪年休假条例 (国务院令第514号) 第三条: 5, 10 or 15 days a year by cumulative service. 第五条: arranged within the year, 一般不跨年度安排; the employer may arrange it across one year only where its work requires.

name: 病假 / 医疗期 (sick leave and medical treatment period)
description: Shanghai: the 沪劳保发〔1995〕83号 scale by service and absence month, at least 80% of the minimum wage. Kunming: 80% of the class minimum wage unless the employer records more. One `facts.event_id` per illness.

references.title: 劳部发〔1994〕479号 第三条 (医疗期); 劳部发〔1995〕309号 第59条 (病假工资不低于最低工资80%); 上海沪劳保发〔1995〕83号 病假工资阶梯; 昆明市工资支付条例 第二十七条.

name: 产假 (statutory maternity leave)
description: Fund-paid (生育津贴): the employer does not pay salary for the days; where the allowance is lower than the salary the city rules decide any top-up (not priced). Metered per birth (`facts.event_id`): 98 days, +15 for a difficult birth (`facts.difficult_birth`), +15 for each further baby (`facts.babies`); a miscarriage (`facts.miscarriage_months`) 15 days under 4 months, 42 from 4.

references.title: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 第七条、第八条: 98天产假, 难产+15天, 多胞胎每多1个+15天; 未满4个月流产15天, 满4个月42天; 生育津贴由基金按单位上年度月平均工资支付.

name: 延长产假 (city extension of maternity leave)
description: 60 days on top of MATERNITY_LEAVE (158 in all), with the same fund-paid treatment. | 60 days on top of MATERNITY_LEAVE (158 in all). Fund-paid with the maternity allowance.

references.title: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 第三十一条; 云南省人口与计划生育条例 第十八条: 符合规定生育的女方延长生育假60天, 与产假合并连续使用, 享受产假同等待遇.

name: 陪产假 / 护理假 (paternity leave)
description: 10 days, taken within the mother's maternity leave, at the normal wage. | 30 days; paid (第三十五条).

references.title: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 第三十一条 (陪产假10天); 云南省人口与计划生育条例 第十八条 (护理假30天), 按正常出勤工资发给.

name: 婚假 (national marriage leave, 3 days)
description: Up to 3 days at full pay.

references.title: (80)劳总薪字29号 第一条: 婚丧假1至3天, 工资照发.
关于国营企业职工请婚丧假和路程假问题的通知 ((80)劳总薪字29号): 酌情给予一至三天的婚丧假, per event.

name: 婚假延长 (city extension of marriage leave)
description: 7 days after MARRIAGE_LEAVE, full pay. | 15 days after MARRIAGE_LEAVE; paid (第三十五条).

references.title: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 第三十一条 (增加婚假7天); 云南省人口与计划生育条例 第十八条 (增加婚假15天), 享受婚假同等待遇.

name: 育儿假 (childcare leave, children under 3)
description: 5 days a year for each parent for each child under 3, metered per calendar year (the regulation counts each child's year from its birth). | 10 days a year (15 with two or more children under 3); the yearly count is not metered; paid (第三十五条).

references.title: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 第三十一条 (每个子女每年5天); 云南省人口与计划生育条例 第十八条 (每年10天, 两个以上不满3周岁子女再增加5天), 按正常出勤工资发给.

name: 产前检查 (prenatal check-ups in working time)
description: Counted as working time, full pay.

references.title: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 第六条第三款: 产前检查时间计入劳动时间.

name: 丧假 (bereavement leave)
description: Up to 3 days at full pay.

references.title: (80)劳总薪字29号 第一条: 直系亲属死亡, 酌情给予1至3天丧假, 工资照发.
关于国营企业职工请婚丧假和路程假问题的通知 ((80)劳总薪字29号): 酌情给予一至三天的婚丧假, per event.

name: 事假 (unpaid personal leave by agreement)
description: Unpaid; this line takes the days.

references.title: 工资支付暂行规定 第十一条、第十二条: 仅法定休假和假期支付工资; 事假由双方约定, 无薪.

name: 事假 (personal leave on full pay under the employer's rules)
description: Personal leave the employer pays in full; 20 days or more in a calendar year forfeit that year's annual leave (ANNUAL_LEAVE).

references.title: 职工带薪年休假条例 第四条(二): 请事假累计20天以上且单位不扣工资的, 不享受当年年休假.

name: 停工留薪期 (paid leave for a work injury)
description: Paid in full by the employer; record the accident date as `facts.accident_date` and one `facts.event_id` per injury. Creating the entry raises the 30-day recognition task.

references.title: 工伤保险条例 第三十三条: 停工留薪期内原工资福利待遇不变, 由单位按月支付, 一般不超过12个月; 第十七条: 30日内申请工伤认定.

name: 依法参加社会活动 (statutory social activities)
description: Paid as normal work.

references.title: 工资支付暂行规定 第十条: 依法参加社会活动期间视同正常劳动支付工资; 昆明市工资支付条例 第二十三条.

name: 哺乳时间 (nursing break, 1 hour a day)
description: Counted as working time, recorded in hours.

references.title: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 第九条第二款: 每天1小时哺乳时间, 多胞胎每多1个婴儿每天增加1小时.

name: 产前假 (antenatal leave, where the city grants it)
description: At most 2.5 months (76 days) per pregnancy (`facts.event_id`); paid at 80% (SICK_PAY_REDUCTION deducts the rest).

references.title: 上海市女职工劳动保护办法 第十二条、第十八条: 妊娠7个月以上可申请产前假2个半月, 工资按80%发给.

name: 哺乳假 (nursing leave, where the city grants it)
description: At most 6.5 months (198 days) per birth; paid at 80%.

references.title: 上海市女职工劳动保护办法 第十六条、第十八条: 哺乳假6个半月, 工资按80%发给.

name: 经期休假 (menstrual-period leave, where the city grants it)
description: Per menstrual period (`facts.event_id`), at full pay. Shanghai: 1 day of 公假 for a woman in the work the 办法 lists (`facts.protected_work`), unless the employer moves her to other work for the period. Kunming: 1–2 days for diagnosed severe dysmenorrhoea (`facts.severe_dysmenorrhea_diagnosed`); the Yunnan rule does not state the pay — seeded at full pay, unverified.

references.title: 上海市女职工劳动保护办法 第八条 (保护作业1天公假); 云南省女职工劳动保护特别规定 第九条第三项 (重度痛经确诊后1至2天), 工资照发.

name: 计划生育手术假 (family-planning surgery leave)
description: Days by `facts.surgery_type` per event; full pay. | Days by `facts.surgery_type` per event; paid by the fund's maternity allowance.

references.title: 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号) 第十九条; 昆明市医保局生育保险政策: 按手术类型给假, 上海按正常出勤工资, 昆明由生育津贴支付.

name: 独生子女护理假 / 照护假 (parent-care leave)
description: 5 working days a year, 7 for an only child (`employee.facts.only_child`); paid as normal attendance here (the regulation's pay wording was not read). | 20 days a year for an only child, 10 otherwise; full pay.

references.title: 上海市老年人权益保障条例 (2025年修正): 每年5个工作日, 独生子女7个; 云南省老年人权益保障条例 第二十四条: 独生子女20天, 非独生子女10天, 工资照发.

name: 探亲假 — 探望配偶 (home-visit leave, spouse)
description: 30 calendar days a year (rest days and holidays inside), plus the travel days granted; full standard wage; state-owned units only, after a year with the employer.

references.title: 国发〔1981〕36号 第三条、第五条: 探望配偶每年一次30天, 路程假另给, 按本人标准工资发给.
国务院关于职工探亲待遇的规定 (国发〔1981〕36号) 第二条、第三条: after one year’s work, a visit to the spouse once a year, 30 days.

name: 探亲假 — 未婚职工探望父母 (home-visit leave, unmarried, parents)
description: 20 calendar days a year plus the travel days granted; none while a two-year 45-day visit falls in the last 24 months.

references.title: 国发〔1981〕36号 第三条、第五条: 未婚职工探望父母每年一次20天, 路程假另给, 按本人标准工资发给.
国务院关于职工探亲待遇的规定 (国发〔1981〕36号) 第二条、第三条: after one year’s work, an unmarried worker visits parents once a year, 20 days.

name: 探亲假 — 未婚职工两年一次探望父母 (home-visit leave, unmarried, parents, every two years)
description: 45 calendar days once in 24 months, in place of the yearly 20 (the unit could not grant it, or the employee chose a two-year visit); none after a yearly visit in the last 12 months.

references.title: 国发〔1981〕36号 第三条、第五条: 未婚职工探望父母可两年一次45天, 路程假另给, 按本人标准工资发给.

name: 探亲假 — 已婚职工探望父母 (home-visit leave, married, parents)
description: 20 calendar days once in 48 months plus the travel days granted.

references.title: 国发〔1981〕36号 第三条、第五条: 已婚职工探望父母每四年一次20天, 路程假另给, 按本人标准工资发给.
